title: GIG-3305: Batch Postmaclone Anonymizer Updates
description: LiveAnonymizer writes a chunk in one UPDATE CASE WHEN statement instead of one UPDATE per row, so produce can finish inside the GitHub-hosted six-hour cap.

test_plan.description: Batched UPDATE covers a chunk, preserves nulls, and falls back per-row
steps: Confirm one UPDATE for a three-row clear, null emails stay null, JSON rewrite stays one statement
Confirm a forced CASE failure falls back to per-row UPDATEs and still anonymizes
